notes.title: From Burnout to Breakthrough
notes.notes:
[b]My Development Journey[/b]
Hello everyone! It's been a long time since I last posted about my game development journey. The past few years have been quite a transformative experience for me.
I started working on Empire of Devil fresh out of college, with ambitious plans to create a complex medieval simulator with deep simulation aspects. As many experienced developers advise, don't try to make a AAA game as your first game, they are damn right. That lesson hit me hard, I used to work 14-16 hours on the game all 7 days. At one point I was so burned out that I just couldn't think or work on it anymore. Then I decided to take a break, make small games first and decided to see how it goes. I released two Tycoon games but both bombed hard but taught me invaluable lessons to make games "FUN" rather than overengineering them while chasing realism. Think what experience or what feel you want to give to the player and work towards it. Making realistic games is good but people play games to enjoy them.

[b]My Game Development Philosophy[/b]
Before telling more about Empire Of Devil I wanted to talk about my game design philosophy What I want to do is to give players freedom, freedom to play as bad guy maybe terrible one, force them to make moral choices and see consequences of their actions. I want them to get a feeling that they are king/ruler whose actions will have consequences not only on them but also on their subjects. I want them to enjoy the game without moral shackles, let them do any weird batshit crazy thing they can think of in the game. For example, a game which I've recently made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1333620/Project_Prison/]Project Prison[/url]: It is a prison simulator where player plays as a prisoner. Think of it more like Sims in the prison but just adult version of it where player can kill, blackmail, threaten other prisoners to get what he wants. He can play as a good guy, finish his term, don't get involved in gangs, join workshops etc. but at the end prison is a bad place—good doesn't survive in hell.

[b]Empire of Devil: Reimagined[/b]
Imagine the same thing but for Medieval world. What would you do if you are king/Lord? Marry multiple times? Have your close people control everything and run your settlement like a concentration camp? Poison rivers and kill all people in the rival settlement or be a good guy and run it like a fine nobleman?

[b]What's Changed:[/b]
I've trimmed down the scale to manageable level while trying to maintain the "Feel"/Experience which I wanted to give to the players.
Now the game starts in a region which due to civil war has been ravaged. Player along with his followers comes across an abandoned settlement where he has to make it again a functional town.
You have to decide on every micro aspect of the settlement management.
Each and every follower will have their own unique goal and schedule based on the way you build your settlement. As a ruler you have to make some tough choices like accepting or rejecting wanderers which is important as imagine you have only one house to allot which can house 3 citizens at the most and at a time two different groups: one Merchant who can setup and run a shop and improve prosperity of the town, or a family of three where father has been killed in the war and mother is there with her two children who have nowhere to go.
I mean you can take both at same time but if you don't have enough housing space for your citizens they will sleep outside which reduces their opinion about you.
Or maybe where you have to force a dead soldier's family who died while saving town to create a space for your special friend.
Overall choices are important. Please understand that game is still in the first person perspective. Town management etc. are handled in some cases in top down view like for building etc. but majority of it is first person game.
With your citizens you have to train militia to protect town against bandits or rival cities. Battles are now small scaled—if I have to say I'm aiming for something like Chivalry but fight system not that complicated(more arcade style but not completely watered down version of it), with max party size at a time around 150 to 200 soldiers on the battlefield.

[b]Development Progress & Timeline[/b]
Now when game will release and how much it has progressed: Well core mechanisms are working well, I need to finetune and make graphics look good and optimize it but overall I have a nice structure on which I can build. As game will be an EA title I will get plenty of time in the future to update and improve it. But I'm hoping to start Alpha testing in Late May.
Also I want to say thanks to all old users who encouraged me when I decided I'm going to take a break. There were lot of helpful comments which helped me a lot during that period.

notes.title: Future & New Game
notes.notes:
Hello,

It is the sixth month of the year, so I thought that it is time to give you an update. Where should I start?

Whenever I write these posts I have a desire to write about things I added in Empire Of Devil, But past few months things were difficult for me. I was working on EOD since last year full time sitting in the home, cutting myself from the outside world and focussing only on the game. My parents were/are supportive but at one point I was completely burned out by developing game daily without taking any break. Well tbf that time was difficult for me, I never experienced such desired to run away from everything. After a month I recovered a bit and did a careful analysis of the game. Game is not bad but I was not satisfied with the result and understood that It will require more money, experience, time. Honestly, I lack the first two. So here's what I did.

[list]
[*] Got a Job
[*] Created a new small scale tycoon simulation game. 
[/list]


The job gave me the financial stability to continue working on my games but I can't work full time for the time being. Also, I made a small game which I will release in August on Steam. Please note that I am not abandoning this game but development will be bit slow for next few months.

notes.title: Animation Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
Sorry for not making an update post last month. Last month was pretty hectic I did an internal beta testing and took a short break of 2-3 weeks.

I am working on EOD since last August full time daily working on the game for 8-10 hrs exhausted me which result in burnout. Thatswhay I decided to take a short break in May to recharge my batteries.
After internal beta testing results were not promising for me. The game feels rough around edges and consists of game threatening bugs. I could have released the game and with the label of "Early Access" made some excuses and promises update etc. but doing such things are not worth it. I set some standards and I am not releasing the game without matching it. I am well aware of my limitations and not expecting to release a masterpiece or something but releasing a broken game in the name early access is not something I want to do as it will not represent efforts, I put in the game last year.


[b]Animation Update[/b]

In past blogs, I explained the swordplay system sword is controlled from the input of the mouse and it will rotate with the mouse direction but In past system animations were static that means if you move the mouse in left direction animation system will play left targetting animation but with the new system and introduction of ik, animations are much flexible. The player can target a specific part of an enemy body like legs.hands.neck, head etc. Which gives different tactical options to both Ai and players.

notes.title: World and Trade System
notes.notes:
Hello, Although I wanted to make a video blog to explain systems I cannot able to make one(My voice really comes weird also text2speech makes it looks robotic) SO I am writing this huge blog explaining many things.
PS: I am attaching some videos at end of this blog so if you hate reading you could just skip this part. but It is important to read it.

[b]World [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/78c4da734f1309a83d4ed448eb2ab11cd89c15c4.png[/img]
 I made this image to show power hierarchy in EOD.


EOD simulates the whole country who is in chaos and player start from the bottom ladder with a goal in the mind to become emperor.
The game allows you to micromanage things also possible to decide strategy based on many things.

The Emperor controls the whole country with his province divided between counts, Counts manages province with every count has his separate court with his province is divided into a number of settlements(villages/towns etc.). Lord control this town they are vassal of the count.
Also, Emperor and his every count have a separate council who works for their liege.

Council Positions are:
[list]
[*] Chancellor
[*] Marshal
[*] Tresurer
[*] Jury
[*] Jailer
[/list]

Every council positions requirer certain attributes like to become chancellor character must have Diplomacy trait higher than other characters.


[b]Titles [/b]

Titles are another important part of hierarchy with every settlement have office with which his owner rules.

Player start as Commoner i.e from a low level of hierarchy but can move upwards on the power ladder, With every title comes with certain benefits
 and more power.

Three titles below Lord are

[list]
[*] Baron
[*] Nobleman
[*] Commoner
[/list]
 Titles are how every citizen is identified and it allowed him to perform various actions like to open a business you must have nobleman title, Or to run for office you also need Baron title
Here are the Office Positions 
[list]
[*] mayor
[*]  Marshal 
[*] Treasurer
[*]  Jury 
[*]  Jailer
[/list]
Every position comes with certain benefits like you can bribe Treasurer to raid your opponent business, Or If you are Jury then you can demand a bribe from a criminal for low punishment etc.

Here is actually how it looks in game
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/4292177ba37909a0c4c92c897f0e919d5efb8de1.png[/img]

With clicking on every province will take you to detail info about that province. Right side shows the Owner of that province with his name age clan he belongs to, Alos his different traits, gold, army size etc.
Below two dropdowns give the option to the player to sort his vassals based upon different parameters, same goes for family list also you can sort with different parameters such as his grandparents, wife, children, uncles, siblings etc. Left side shows settlement info with his population info from every citizen divided into different class/Religion etc.

[b]Population[/b]
So now a population of settlement is divided into 3 classes(Low, Middle, Upper) every class have different needs like low and middle class needs common items(Food items like Salt etc, Metals for workers like Iron, Copper, Bronze etc)
while Upper class needs luxury items(Gold, Silver, Spices etc.)
Also, every settlement now generates different Resources so first generated good will be consumed in common market then allowed to sell in world market so the price of a good in that particular region will be dependent on Supply-Demand rule. So if player trade perfectly(buying an item from surplus supply region and selling in high demand region for profit). Also player now needs to have certain Title to able to trade, Player could buy a title from regions office.(It also allows for black marketing goods)

[b]Tariffs and Spending[/b]
Every owner of settlement decide tariff applied on imported goods which sometimes makes goods more costly and deteriorating relationship with that regions owner basically it allows you to become Tarrifman
Also need to allow basic %spendings on different factors such as Education, Administration, Military Budget, Building Budget etc.


[b]Trade[/b]

Trade window shows trade info for every resource with where it produced throughout the map and need vs population also a chart showing past 6 months activity for the price, production, need.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/4151d3ed4c62f09c68cdf59ae69f2cbbbdd3602c.png[/img]

Image shows different trade resources available in the game.[url=https://youtu.be/qO399pb6BuI]Video Shows how to buy[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/Pqe3S3dpGxA]Video shows buying swords[/url]
PS: If you click on an item it will rotate to let you see the full view.
 
This becomes huge blog though :)
Here are a few more videos showing npc daily activities they have their own different schedule and ai for behaviour.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bACFVqmKxcw]Planting tree[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ejUAIuxuyP8]Activity 2[/url]

Also, hd version is very much is in works here is a small video
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nbhtcj4zHC0]Standing FPS capture[/url]

Also I am going to release beta just fixing and balancing things sorry for delay.

notes.title: Combat System
notes.notes: Hello, In EOD swordfight is direction based you can control sword by mouse means the game will track mouse movement and move sword accordingly. If the player moves the mouse to the right direction then the player will attack from the right side. If the mouse moves to the upper left corner then the player will attack enemy head from the left side, If low right corner then the sword is positioned to attack the right leg of the enemy. It is a straightforward system but my end goal is to make it more physics driven I am planning to complete it by 0.4 or 0.6  beta version. Enemies also have the same system implemented to them, Every part of the body have some modifier value what it basically does is If a certain part of the body is targetted continuously then it will increase damage done by the blow, So Ai will try to target already damaged part.

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/4b67fce7f30c832cffa0bf27291dce9f6c4011c7.png[/img]

Hello, In EOD main map is divided between provinces and each contains 20-30 villages. The town is the main centre of the provinces.
Each town is controlled by the Lord and all villages in that region owned by him which he can distribute in his vassals. Every village/town requires food depend upon its population, If food requirement is not met than it will affect moral and reduces income.
[b]Taxation[/b]
Every rular can decide tax to impose n his settlements but more tax more people becomes unhappy and can cause riots.
[b]Build[/b]
Owner of settlement can choose what to build or upgrade existing buildings.
Every building gave certain income and requires maintaince cost. like if you found you'r settlement is starving it is best to build food generating buildings.
[b]Vassals[/b]
Character will decide(according to his traits) tax for his vassals, Vassals can provide levies for war. If vassal becomes more powerful then his liege he could declares independace also demanding too much tax from vassals will make them angry and they can form group and they can try to overthrow liege. 

The most important thing is Traits of the character as every character have his own unique goal and he will try to achieve his goals based upon his personality traits.

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/133857794ee3ea3b7d382b060f83bb8d7d0426a8.png[/img][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/133857794ee3ea3b7d382b060f83bb8d7d0426a8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33714142/114265645c34bca977a65c55f7d52620b56b013d.png[/img][/url]

Hello, In EOD Player start his journey as a normal man without any money or special skills he is just another man in the power-hungry world. To earn money player can become a merchant and travel across world selling goods.
Price of goods depends on many aspects but the most important part is the ratio of supply and demand. Every city/village needs a certain amount of goods(Food/Metal/Luxury Items) their cost based upon the ratio. Best way to earn money is to buy low sell high easiest way is to reduce supply to inflate the price by threatening other merchants or bribing them or killing them. Also, other factors also count like war etc.
PS: You can also loot the stores to make some money, In the next part I will give more info about creating crime organizations.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
1) The major challenge of creating this game is to render thousands of Ai soldier each with individual ai etc. Few games in a similar category as of this game gives the ability to the player to run riot with thousands of ai soldiers but not allowed to control a single soldier or player character In case of RPG games max count of the individual soldier is in few hundreds each with unique ai and physics. While making EOD I want to blend both things together to give player ability to control thousands of soldier and also kill enemy soldiers with his sword. In early build maximum amount of soldiers controlled by the player are 700-1000(30-45fps). Last month I spend the majority of time to solve this problem because king with an army of 500 soldiers is just idiotic. So I need to rewrite 80% my previously written code, trade-off many things and finally, I can render soldiers I always wish for. In my last test, I can manage to run with 7500-11000 soldier at solid 60 fps on GTX 1050ti. I am still improving many things from pathfinding to collision checking but I am happy with the progress I made.
2)Towns and Villages: In EOD, I almost changed over 10s of times their design I am still not satisfied with it but I am planning to improve them later on early access.
3)NPC-Ai: Now each NPC ai will have their own schedule but they are not just brain-dead zombies roaming from one place to another. They will act and behave according to player actions
4)How complete is the game: To be fair If I want I can release game even tomorrow but I keep adding things into it. Anyways also all images and trailer are from last build game look much better now. After confirming a few things I will change them later.

notes.title: Tactics Creator
notes.notes:
In Empire Of Devil Before going to war player have a variety of option to set the shape of the army and give specific instruction to each unit.

The shape of the army is generally divided into three parts Centre, Flanks and Reserve. 

From Formation window player can divide army units in different formation.
Player can also assign strength of unit as in one unit max amount of soldier is 250. With sorting option give choice of soldier included in unit by sorting with their Level andHealth.

From movement, window player can give movement instruction to a specific unit. 
1) Setting the target unit, 
2) Attacking on flank 
3) Rear attack etc.
4) Chain movements

From Unit Order player gives instruction to ai what to do in various conditions like. 
1)Outnumbered by an enemy unit.
2)Attacked by the ranged unit.
3)Enemy unit is routing.etc.

With Advanced window, player can give instruction to individual soldier in Each unit. Soldier Ai will follow rules set by the player.

notes.title: Marriages in Empire Of Devil
notes.notes:
In Empire Of Devil, man can marry up to 6 times. Once the ruler died the oldest child inherits primary titles and other titles are distributed between other children. Once player character died the game will allow you to choose the character among his children you can also randomize this process by allowing game to select character for you.
     Wives like to see their children on the throne and plot schemes against the current heir. If they have enough influence on their husband they will force him to change succession order.  
Marriages are great ways to form Alliance with other factions. These factions also support the child by that marriage if succession war happens. Characters can also choose to elope, making an enemy with the faction.

notes.title: What is Empire Of Devil
notes.notes:
Hello, Empire Of Devil is a hybrid of Rpg and RTS Genre. The main theme of this game is power corrupts. It gives you feel of being a king in the medieval era. You start your journey as a Nobel in the kingdom as with increasing influence your social and political standing increases.
        Empire Of Devil contains in depth diplomacy to tactics manager to control your forces on the battlefield. You can control thousands of troops like an RTS game but still need to lead in them on the battlefield for the glory. Over course of next few days, I will talk about the Inner working of features in the Empire Of Devils. Thanks
